[EN] [Important] To the Engine Room
[ES] [Importante] A la sala de máquinas
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Ready."
[ES] Listo.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Speak with Jelena.
[ES] Habla con Jelena.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Activate the alarm to distract the enemy.
[ES] Activa la alarma para distraer al enemigo.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] You insignificant worm...
[ES] Insignificante gusano...
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] You stop here!
[ES] ¡Aquí te detienes!
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Defeat the Draakon Lieutenant in Verrak Fortress.
[ES] Derrota al teniente draakon en la Fortaleza Verrak.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Aheaf's Hideout.
[ES] Escondite de Aheaf.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Someone is whispering your name.
[ES] Alguien te susurra al oído.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Go to the upper level of Verrak Fortress and find Aheaf's Hideout.
[ES] Ve al nivel superior de la Fortaleza Verrak y encuentra el Escondite de Aheaf.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Thanks."
[ES] "Gracias."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Speak with Aheaf in the upper level of Verrak Fortress.
[ES] Habla con Aheaf en el nivel superior de la Fortaleza Verrak.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Rogash will be pleased to see your body!
[ES] ¡Rogash se alegrará de ver tu cadáver!
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Lagos...!
[ES] ¡Lagos...!
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Defeat the Draakon Ravagers in the upper level of Verrak Fortress.
[ES] Derrota a los devastadores draakon en el nivel superior de la Fortaleza Verrak.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Okay."
[ES] "Está bien."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Speak with Jelena.
[ES] Habla con Jelena.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Square
[ES] Plaza
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] There too many of them.
[ES] Hay demasiados.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Go downstairs.
[ES] Baja las escaleras.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Defeat Draakon Dominators and Draakon Watchers in Verrak Fortress Depths.
[ES] Derrota a los dominadores draakon y vigilantes draakon en las profundidades de la Fortaleza Verrak.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Stay safe."
[ES] "Mantente a salvo."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Speak with Jelena.
[ES] Habla con Jelena.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Defeat the Draakon Pursuer in Verrak Fortress Depths.
[ES] Derrota al perseguidor draakon en las profundidades de Verrak Fortress.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Cloistered Corridor
[ES] Pasillo Clausurado
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Aheaf appeared.
[ES] Aheaf apareció.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Go to the Cloistered Corridor.
[ES] Ve al Pasillo Clausurado.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Thank you."
[ES] "Gracias."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Speak with Aheaf in the Abyss Corridor.
[ES] Habla con Aheaf en el Pasillo del Abismo.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "Yes."
[ES] "Sí."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Speak with Jelena in front of the Engine Room.
[ES] Habla con Jelena frente a la Sala de Máquinas.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
